entries.title: Live Panoramax federation verification — 2026-09-07
entries.summary: ## Live Panoramax federation verification — 2026-09-07 **Decision: keep Panoramax gated and disabled by default.** The public federation is technically usable without a key, but the observed US coverage is too sparse and is often ordinary sequence photography rather than navigable 360 imagery.

entries.title: Loading and operational limits
entries.summary: ## Loading and operational limits - Probe providers server-side in priority order with short timeouts and circuit breakers. Cache only normalized availability metadata briefly; follow each provider’s terms for image caching. - Start rendering after the first accepted candidate.
